blocks.en: This page details the mechanics of mining ore. For a step-by-step beginner guide, see Mining Primer for Complete Beginners. For details about harvesting ice or gas, see Ice harvesting or Gas cloud harvesting, respectively.
blocks.zh: 本页详细介绍开采矿石的机制。新手分步指南请参阅零基础采矿入门。冰矿或气云采集的详细信息，请分别参阅冰矿采集或气云采集。

blocks.en: Mining is the activity of extracting ore from asteroids, though it is also used to describe ice harvesting and more rarely, gas cloud harvesting. Once extracted, ore can then be refined into minerals. These refined substances are used in the production and maintenance of all player-created items and structures in EVE, such as ships and modules. It is one of the few professions immediately available to beginning players and many industrialists started their careers by mining. Mining is considered a very economically safe profession, as minerals are always in demand. Mining requires specialized modules or drones, and specialized mining ships also exist.
blocks.zh: 采矿是从小行星中开采矿石的活动，不过这个词也用来指冰矿采集，较少情况下也指气云采集。矿石开采出来后，可以提炼成矿物。这些提炼产物用于生产和维护 EVE 中所有由玩家制造的物品和建筑，比如舰船和装备。采矿是新手一上来就能从事的少数几个职业之一，许多工业玩家的生涯都是从采矿开始的。由于矿物的需求永远存在，采矿被认为是经济上非常稳妥的职业。采矿需要专门的装备或无人机，另外也有专门的采矿舰船。

blocks.en: As a profession
blocks.zh: 作为一种职业

blocks.en: It ain't no trick to get rich quick If you dig with a shovel or a pick In a mine, where a million diamonds shine.
blocks.zh: 挖呀挖，发财其实不难，只要你拿着铲子或镐头，在那闪耀着百万颗钻石的矿井里。

blocks.en: Advantages
blocks.zh: 优点

en: Low entry cost: The Venture mining frigate is provided for free as a mission reward from the career agent missions Balancing the Books (2 of 10) and Making Mountains of Molehills (2 of 10).
Relatively low risk: It is usually very safe to mine in high-sec (the principal dangers being suicide gankers or war targets).

Low level of involvement needed: In most scenarios, miners only need to be active 5 seconds for every 3 minutes (to target new asteroids) and an extra 1 minute for every 30 minutes (to unload the full cargo of mined ore in station).

Guaranteed income: Mining products are always in high demand because ships and structures are constantly being destroyed and replaced, and replacing ships and structures requires materials. Mining in fleets with boosts can earn 15–20 million ISK per hour or more, depending on the resources being harvested.
Fun factor: Mining in fleets is often a very social activity.
zh: 入门成本低：冲锋者级采矿护卫舰是生涯代理人任务收支平衡（2/10）和积少成多（2/10）的免费奖励。
风险相对较低：在高安采矿通常非常安全（主要危险来自自杀式攻击者或战争目标）。
投入精力少：大多数情况下，矿工每 3 分钟只需操作 5 秒（锁定新的小行星），每 30 分钟再额外花 1 分钟（回空间站卸下满舱的矿石）。
收入有保障：舰船和建筑不断被摧毁和替换，而替换它们需要材料，所以采矿产品的需求始终很旺盛。在有加成的舰队中采矿，每小时可赚 1500–2000 万 ISK 甚至更多，具体取决于采集的资源。
趣味性：舰队采矿往往是一项很有社交氛围的活动。

blocks.en: Disadvantages
blocks.zh: 缺点

en: Skill intensive: Despite the low entry cost, it takes a lot of training time to become an efficient miner.
Non-transferable skills: Mining skills are useful only for mining.
Fun factor: Solo mining, in particular, can be less than exciting. Mining fleets can provide conversation with other players in comms, but there usually isn't much going on otherwise.

Income ceiling: It is difficult to earn much more than 10 million ISK per hour mining solo in highsec. While it's possible to earn more money mining in lower-security systems (at higher risk), other professions can be much more lucrative.
zh: 技能要求高：虽然入门成本低，但要成为高效的矿工需要大量训练时间。
技能无法通用：采矿技能只对采矿有用。
趣味性：尤其是单人采矿，可能不太刺激。采矿舰队里可以在语音中和其他玩家聊天，但除此之外通常没什么事情发生。
收入上限：在高安单人采矿，每小时很难赚到远超 1000 万 ISK。虽然在安全等级更低的星系采矿能赚更多（风险也更高），但其他职业的收益可能要高得多。

blocks.en: Ore locations
blocks.zh: 矿石分布

blocks.en: Asteroids and belts
blocks.zh: 小行星与小行星带

blocks.en: Main article: Asteroids and ore
blocks.zh: 主条目：小行星与矿石

blocks.en: As their name suggests, asteroids are primarily found in asteroid belts, and most systems in New Eden have at least one. Asteroid belts can be viewed in the overview when enabled, and can also be viewed via the contextual menu by right-clicking in space. Each asteroid belt is composed of a variety of asteroids, each containing a particular type of ore noted in asteroid's name. The types and quantities of ore are determined by the system security rating of the system and which quadrant it is located in. Rarer and more valuable ores are found in lower-security systems, and ore deposits tend to be larger there as well. Once depleted, asteroid belts do not respawn until server downtime, so belts may sometimes be found empty, or lacking a certain type of ore.
blocks.zh: 顾名思义，小行星主要分布在小行星带中，新伊甸的大多数星系至少有一条小行星带。开启相应设置后可以在总览中看到小行星带，也可以在太空中右键打开菜单查看。每条小行星带由多种小行星组成，每颗小行星含有一种特定的矿石，矿石种类就写在小行星的名字里。矿石的种类和数量取决于星系的安全等级以及它所在的象限。更稀有、更值钱的矿石分布在安全等级更低的星系，那里的矿藏通常也更大。小行星带被采空后，要到服务器维护后才会刷新，所以有时会遇到空的小行星带，或者缺少某种矿石。

en: High-sec belts contain simple ores (Veldspar, Scordite, Pyroxeres and Plagioclase).
Low-sec belts contain coherent ores (Omber, Kernite, Jaspet, Hemorphite and Hedbergite) and additionaly Pyroxeres.
Null-sec belts contain complex ores (Bistot, Arkonor and Spodumain), special ore Mercoxit and additionally Kernite, Pyroxeres and Veldspar.
Triglavian space belts contain abyssal ores (Bezdnacine, Rakovene and Talassonite).
Wormhole belts contain Arkonor, Bistot, Gneiss, Kernite, Omber, and Pyroxeres.
zh: 高安小行星带含有简单矿石（凡晶石、灼烧岩、干焦岩和斜长岩）。
低安小行星带含有连贯矿石（奥贝尔石、水硼砂、杰斯贝矿、希莫非特和同位原矿），另外还有干焦岩。
00 区小行星带含有复杂矿石（双多特石、艾克诺岩和灰岩）、特殊矿石基腹断岩，另外还有水硼砂、干焦岩和凡晶石。
三神裔空间的小行星带含有深渊矿石（贝兹岩、拉克岩和塔拉岩）。
虫洞小行星带含有艾克诺岩、双多特石、片麻岩、水硼砂、奥贝尔石和干焦岩。

blocks.en: Mission pockets
blocks.zh: 任务空间

blocks.en: Asteroids can also be found in the deadspace pockets created for certain missions. While these sites are a bit more difficult to find, they also tend to have no competition giving richer pickings and provide relative safety.
blocks.zh: 在为某些任务生成的死亡空间中也能找到小行星。这些地点稍微难找一些，但通常没有人竞争，收获更丰富，也相对安全。

blocks.en: Cosmic Anomalies
blocks.zh: 宇宙异常

blocks.en: Asteroids can also be found in certain cosmic anomalies. Generally the type of ore matches the regular ore from the asteroid belts in this area of New Eden but there is an important exception referred to by players as border/A0 ores. These ores provide a high amount of a singular resource.
blocks.zh: 某些宇宙异常中也有小行星。一般来说，其中的矿石种类与新伊甸该区域小行星带中的常规矿石一致，但有一个重要的例外，玩家称之为边境 / A0 矿石。这些矿石能提供大量的某一种资源。

blocks.en: Border/A0 ores are Ducinium(Megacyte), Eifyrium(Zydrine), Mordunium(Pyerite) and Ytirium(Isogen). They are found in special cosmic anomalies that infrequently spawn.
blocks.zh: 边境 / A0 矿石包括杜厦合金（超噬矿）、埃菲尔合金（晶状石英核岩）、莫德合金（类晶体胶矿）和耶利合金（同位聚合体）。它们出现在不常刷新的特殊宇宙异常中。

blocks.en: Rare asteroid sites
blocks.zh: 稀有小行星站点

blocks.en: Opportunities tile
blocks.zh: 机遇面板

blocks.en: All sites spawn a beacon upon the first ship initiating warp to it which anyone can warp to.
blocks.zh: 所有站点在第一艘舰船开始向其跃迁时会生成一个信标，任何人都可以跃迁过去。

en: Empire Border Rare Asteroids Spawns in high-sec 0.5 systems bordering a low-sec system. Contains asteroids with Ducinium, Eifyrium, Dark Ochre IV-Grade, Crokite IV-Grade, and Ytirium.
zh: 帝国边境稀有小行星：出现在与低安星系相邻的 0.5 高安星系。含有杜厦合金、埃菲尔合金、黑赭石（4级）、克洛基石（4级）和耶利合金小行星。

en: Nullsec Border Rare Asteroids Spawns in null-sec systems bordering a low-sec system. Contains asteroids with Ducinium IV-Grade, Eifyrium IV-Grade, Mordunium, Crokite IV-Grade, and Ytirium IV-Grade.
zh: 00 区边境稀有小行星：出现在与低安星系相邻的 00 区星系。含有杜厦合金（4级）、埃菲尔合金（4级）、莫德合金、克洛基石（4级）和耶利合金（4级）小行星。

en: Nullsec Blue A0 Rare Asteroids Spawns in Blue A0 star systems in null-sec space [Verify]. Contains asteroids with Ducinium IV-Grade, Eifyrium IV-Grade, Dark Ochre IV-Grade, Mordunium IV-Grade and Ytirium IV-Grade.
zh: 00 区蓝色 A0 稀有小行星：出现在 00 区的蓝色 A0 恒星星系 [待核实]。含有杜厦合金（4级）、埃菲尔合金（4级）、黑赭石（4级）、莫德合金（4级）和耶利合金（4级）小行星。

en: Wormhole Rare Asteroids Spawns in (Blue A0 star systems) in wormhole space.
zh: 虫洞稀有小行星：出现在虫洞空间的（蓝色 A0 恒星）星系。

blocks.en: Moon mining
blocks.zh: 卫星采矿

blocks.en: Main article: Moon mining
blocks.zh: 主条目：卫星采矿

blocks.en: Moon mining can take place only at refineries anchored within 250 km of a mining beacon in 0.5 space or below and fitted with a Standup Moon Drill I service module, which appears on the outside of the structure as a giant laser turret aimed at the moon. The Moon Drill is then used to extract a chunk of the moon for mining. The extraction process is beyond the scope of this article, but once the chunk has been extracted, it exists as an asteroid field that contains moon-specific ores which can be mined for moon materials. After extraction, the mining is performed using the same mining equipment and processes described in this article, with the exception of Tier 2 strip miners and modulated mining lasers requiring moon ore-specific crystals for good efficiency.
blocks.zh: 卫星采矿只能在精炼厂进行：精炼厂须锚定在 0.5 及以下星系的采矿信标 250 km 范围内，并装配屹立卫星钻探 I 服务装备，它在建筑外部表现为一座瞄准卫星的巨型激光炮塔。卫星钻探用来从卫星上拉出一块碎块供开采。提取过程不在本文讨论范围内，但碎块被拉出后会形成一片小行星区，其中含有卫星专属矿石，可以开采出卫星材料。提取完成后，开采使用的设备和流程与本文所述相同，唯一的区别是 T2 露天采矿器和调制型采矿激光器需要专用于卫星矿石的晶体才能达到较好的效率。

blocks.en: Mining missions
blocks.zh: 采矿任务

blocks.en: Main article: Mining missions
blocks.zh: 主条目：采矿任务

blocks.en: Mining missions are given by Mining agents and require you to mine an asteroid or set of asteroids in a mission pocket—usually until the asteroids are depleted—and bring the ore back to the agent. They use unique mission ores which are separate versions of normal ores.
blocks.zh: 采矿任务由采矿代理人发布，要求你在任务空间中开采一颗或一组小行星（通常要采到小行星耗尽为止），然后把矿石带回给代理人。这些任务使用独特的任务矿石，它们是普通矿石的单独版本。

blocks.en: Mining mechanics
blocks.zh: 采矿机制

blocks.en: Mechanics
blocks.zh: 机制

blocks.en: The basic mechanics of mining are very simple: Fit your ship with a mining module, approach and target an asteroid, and activate your mining module. At the end of each cycle (usually between 15 and 45 seconds, depending on the module used), the ore mined is automatically deposited in your ship's cargo or mining hold. The mining module will then automatically continue mining until either your cargo/mining hold is full, or the asteroid has been "mined out" (all the available ore in that asteroid has been mined and it disappears). Make sure that you keep the asteroid within range of your mining module (usually by stopping your ship, or orbiting the asteroid)—if you are too far away, the mining module will finish its current cycle regardless, but you will receive no ore.
blocks.zh: 采矿的基本机制非常简单：给舰船装上采矿装备，接近并锁定一颗小行星，然后激活采矿装备。在每个周期结束时（通常为 15 到 45 秒，取决于所用装备），采到的矿石会自动存入舰船的货舱或矿石舱。之后采矿装备会自动继续开采，直到货舱 / 矿石舱装满，或者小行星被“采空”（小行星里的矿石全部采完并消失）。务必让小行星保持在采矿装备的射程内（通常是让船停下，或者环绕小行星）——如果距离太远，采矿装备仍会完成当前周期，但你得不到任何矿石。

blocks.en: If you're using mining drones, launch your drones once you are near the asteroid, and give them the command to "mine repeatedly". They will then fly to the asteroid you have targeted, mine for one cycle (60 seconds), fly back to your ship, deposit the ore they have mined in your cargo or mining hold, then automatically fly back to the asteroid and continue mining it (until, as above, either your cargo/mining hold is full, or the asteroid has depleted because it no longer contains any ore). Since the drones have to fly back and forth repeatedly between your ship and the asteroid, it's worth flying as close as possible to the asteroid to keep their travel time down to a minimum.
blocks.zh: 如果你使用采矿无人机，在靠近小行星后释放无人机，并下达“重复采矿”指令。它们会飞到你锁定的小行星，开采一个周期（60 秒），飞回你的船，把采到的矿石存入货舱或矿石舱，然后自动飞回小行星继续开采（同上，直到货舱 / 矿石舱装满，或者小行星矿石耗尽）。由于无人机要在你的船和小行星之间反复往返，尽量靠近小行星以缩短它们的飞行时间是值得的。

blocks.en: Once your cargo or mining hold is full, bring the ore you have mined to a station (either fly there yourself or transfer the ore to another player's ship to fly back (see solo mining and cooperative mining for more details), then return to the asteroids and continue mining!
blocks.zh: 货舱或矿石舱满了之后，把采到的矿石送到空间站（自己飞回去，或者转给另一位玩家的船运回去，详见单人采矿和合作采矿部分），然后回到小行星继续采矿！

blocks.en: Critical yield
blocks.zh: 暴击产量

blocks.en: Mining lasers, strip miners, and ice harvesters can experience critical successes, granting bonus yield without reducing the remaining ore in the asteroids (gas in clouds). The chance of a critical success starts at 1% and the bonus yield from a critical success starts at 200% of the standard yield of that cycle.
blocks.zh: 采矿激光器、露天采矿器和冰矿采集器可能触发暴击，获得额外产量，且不会减少小行星中剩余的矿石（气云中的气体）。暴击几率初始为 1%，暴击的额外产量初始为该周期标准产量的 200%。

blocks.en: Both values can be increased through:
blocks.zh: 这两个数值都可以通过以下方式提高：

en: skills
Mining Precision increases the success chance
Mining Exploitation increases the bonus yield
modules
Mining Survey Chipset increases success chance and bonus yield, and decreases mining residue chance
Mining Foreman Bursts loaded with Mining Laser Efficiency. Increases critical yield success chance and decreases mining residue chance.
zh: 技能
采矿精度提高暴击几率
矿石开采提高暴击额外产量
装备
采矿调查芯片组提高暴击几率和暴击额外产量，并降低采矿残渣几率
装填采矿激光器效率弹药的开采先锋脉冲波。提高暴击产量的几率，并降低采矿残渣几率。

blocks.en: Critical success notification will appear on-screen with added audio and visual cues.
blocks.zh: 暴击时屏幕上会出现提示，并伴有额外的音效和视觉效果。

blocks.en: Integrated Mining Surveyor
blocks.zh: 内置采矿勘测器

blocks.en: All ORE mining ships and all basic empire corvettes come equipped with a built-in Mining Surveyor, providing immediate access to in-space resource data without requiring a separate module.
blocks.zh: 所有联合矿业采矿舰船和所有帝国基础轻型护卫舰都内置了采矿勘测器（Mining Surveyor），无需单独的装备即可直接获取太空中的资源数据。

blocks.en: The Mining Surveyor has a dynamic overlay, displaying colour-coded visual indicators of asteroid value directly in space. The overlay can be toggled ON or OFF via the scanner button on the HUD.
blocks.zh: 采矿勘测器带有动态叠加层，直接在太空中以颜色标示小行星的价值。可以通过 HUD 上的扫描按钮开启或关闭叠加层。

en: Turning Overlay ON: By clicking the Scan button, your ship performs a mining scan and displays colour-coded visual overlays on nearby asteroids. These overlays highlight relative value tiers and estimated ISK to give players an immediate, at-a-glance view of the most profitable targets in range.
Clicking the scan button again will re-scan your surroundings.
Turn Overlay OFF: Player can also right-click the scan button to disable the overlay. All the current scan data will be retained within the survey scan result window until player re-scan.
zh: 开启叠加层：点击扫描按钮后，你的舰船会进行一次采矿扫描，并在附近的小行星上显示按颜色区分的叠加标识。这些标识会突出显示相对价值档次和预估 ISK 价值，让玩家一眼就能看出范围内最赚钱的目标。
再次点击扫描按钮会重新扫描周围环境。
关闭叠加层：玩家也可以右键点击扫描按钮来关闭叠加层。当前所有扫描数据会保留在勘测扫描结果窗口中，直到玩家重新扫描。

blocks.en: Mining Surveyors have to be manually activated; a scan pulse starts immediately, taking 10 seconds to travel outward to a distance of 250 km.
blocks.zh: 采矿勘测器需要手动激活；扫描脉冲会立即发出，用 10 秒向外扩散到 250 km 的距离。

blocks.en: Right-clicking the mining surveyor scan button gives the options of opening the scan results window and the mining ledger.
blocks.zh: 右键点击采矿勘测器扫描按钮，可以选择打开扫描结果窗口和采矿记录（Mining Ledger）。

blocks.en: Mining survey chipset
blocks.zh: 采矿调查芯片组

blocks.en: (top-left) Real-time gauge showing red for residue (if any) and green for ore output; (center) Total Value and Quantity readouts are available.
blocks.zh: （左上）实时仪表，红色表示残渣（如有），绿色表示矿石产出；（中间）可以查看总价值和数量读数。

blocks.en: The Mining Survey Chipset is a passive mid-slot module that enhances the mining surveyor with detailed information on the number of units of ore available in nearby asteroids. It also provides bonuses to mining critical success chance and mining critical success bonus yield, as well as a reduction in mining residue chance.
blocks.zh: 采矿调查芯片组是一种被动中槽装备，能为采矿勘测器提供附近小行星中矿石剩余单位数量的详细信息。它还能提高采矿暴击几率和采矿暴击额外产量，并降低采矿残渣几率。

en: Only one mining survey chipset module can be fit at a time.
The mining survey chipset is available in Basic, Tech 1, Compact, and Tech 2 versions.
zh: 同一时间只能装配一个采矿调查芯片组。
采矿调查芯片组有基础型、T1、紧凑型和 T2 几种版本。

blocks.en: It also shows how much ore each asteroid in the vicinity contains. This is important, as asteroid mining modules (mining lasers and strip miners) will always complete an entire cycle (15s for mining lasers, 45s for strip miners), irrespective of how much ore is actually left in the asteroid.
blocks.zh: 它还会显示附近每颗小行星含有多少矿石。这一点很重要，因为小行星采矿装备（采矿激光器和露天采矿器）总会完成一整个周期（采矿激光器 15 秒，露天采矿器 45 秒），不管小行星里实际还剩多少矿石。

blocks.en: For instance, say you are mining an asteroid that contains 100 units of Veldspar (Veldspar has a volume of 0.1 m3 per unit, so this asteroid contains 10 m3 of Veldspar). Your Mining Laser I has a yield of (say) 100 m3/min, and a cycle time of 15 seconds. Even though there are only 10 m3 of Veldspar left in the asteroid, the module will complete its entire 15 second cycle before shutting off (with a message saying "the asteroid is depleted")—but those 15 seconds of mining only yielded 10 m3 of ore (instead 25 m3)! The problem becomes even worse when using strip miners, as they have a much higher yield and a cycle time three times as long—which can result in a lot of wasted time if you're mining asteroids that don't contain much ore.
blocks.zh: 举个例子，假设你正在开采一颗含有 100 单位凡晶石的小行星（凡晶石每单位体积 0.1 m3，所以这颗小行星含有 10 m3 凡晶石）。你的采矿激光器 I 产量（假设）为 100 m3/分钟，周期 15 秒。尽管小行星里只剩 10 m3 凡晶石，装备仍会完成整整 15 秒的周期才关闭（并提示“小行星已耗尽”）——但这 15 秒的开采只得到了 10 m3 矿石（而不是 25 m3）！使用露天采矿器时问题更严重，因为它们产量高得多，周期也长三倍——如果你开采的小行星矿石不多，会浪费大量时间。

blocks.en: If an asteroid is almost empty, you can "short-cycle" your mining laser (i.e. turn it off manually before it completes its full cycle, by clicking on it) to mine out the last dregs of ore before moving on to another asteroid. Note that each time you activate your mining laser it takes energy from your ship's capacitor; activate it too often and you might empty your capacitor and have to wait a moment for it to recharge.
blocks.zh: 如果小行星快空了，你可以“短周期”使用采矿激光器（即在完成整个周期前手动点击关闭），把最后一点矿石采完再换下一颗小行星。注意每次激活采矿激光器都会消耗舰船电容的能量；激活太频繁可能会耗空电容，不得不等它回充一会儿。

blocks.en: Efficiency computations
blocks.zh: 效率计算

blocks.en: Main article: Mining yield
blocks.zh: 主条目：采矿产量

blocks.en: All computations with income from mining are typically done in (ISK per m3). The reason for this is that all mining modules mine a certain volume of ore/ice/gas in a given time. For example, a beginner miner in a Venture with, say, 200 m3/min yield would mine 2000 units of Veldspar per minute, as volume of 1 unit is 0.1 m3, or, for example, 100 units of Jaspet per minute, as volume of 1 unit is 2 m3. Therefore it makes sense to compare not prices per unit, but prices per m3.
blocks.zh: 采矿收入的计算通常都以 ISK/m3 为单位。原因是所有采矿装备在一定时间内开采的都是一定体积的矿石 / 冰矿 / 气云。例如，一位驾驶冲锋者级、产量为 200 m3/分钟的新手矿工，每分钟能采 2000 单位凡晶石，因为 1 单位的体积是 0.1 m3；而杰斯贝矿每分钟只能采 100 单位，因为 1 单位的体积是 2 m3。因此比较每单位价格没有意义，应该比较每 m3 的价格。

blocks.en: Since the market is player-driven, ore and mineral prices are ever-changing, hence miners should always check the market for the most efficient ore/mineral to mine for. Websites like Cerlestes ore table can look up the current market prices for ores and minerals, and give you a recommendation on which ores are the most profitable. Remember to double-check the prices that any automated tools give you—they will often use regional averages to determine mineral prices; if you plan to sell your goods at a specific station or hub then your priorities might come out differently. Lastly, most expensive types of ore are typically associated with most dangerous parts of New Eden so you might want to limit yourself to safer areas.
blocks.zh: 由于市场由玩家主导，矿石和矿物价格一直在变化，所以矿工应当经常查看市场，找出最划算的矿石 / 矿物。Cerlestes ore table 之类的网站可以查询矿石和矿物的当前市场价格，并推荐最赚钱的矿石。记得对任何自动化工具给出的价格做二次核对——它们常用星域平均价来计算矿物价格；如果你打算在某个特定空间站或贸易中心出售，优先级可能会不同。最后，最贵的矿石通常分布在新伊甸最危险的区域，所以你可能需要只在较安全的地方活动。

blocks.en: Once you have chosen a type of ore, you will want to maximize the mining yield over time. This involves choosing what ship to mine in, what modules to fit to it, and what skills to train; see those links for more details.
blocks.zh: 选定矿石种类之后，你要做的就是最大化单位时间的采矿产量。这包括选择用什么舰船采矿、装配什么装备、训练哪些技能；详情请参阅这些链接。

blocks.en: Do not forget to include Hauling time into your profitability computations. There may be different strategies involving Compression or lack of such, Refining ore or selling it in raw form, selling locally or in Jita, hauling yourself or paying someone to do it.
blocks.zh: 别忘了把运输时间算进收益里。可以有不同的策略：是否压缩，把矿石提炼还是直接卖原矿，在本地卖还是拉到吉他 卖，自己运还是花钱请人运。

blocks.en: Compression
blocks.zh: 压缩

blocks.en: The Rorqual, backbone of null-sec mining operation, released with a signature ability known as the ore compression, which is now available to Orca and Porpoise too.
blocks.zh: 长须鲸级是 00 区采矿作业的中坚力量，推出时带有一项招牌能力——矿石压缩，如今逆戟鲸级和海豚级也具备这项能力。

blocks.en: Main article: Compression
blocks.zh: 主条目：压缩

blocks.en: Raw ores are very large items and they take a lot of cargo space to haul. The compression offers to convert raw ore into compressed ore which allows to save valuable cargo-space, extended operation time for mining fleets, and more hauling capabilities for haulers. There are two ways of compression: visiting an Upwell Structure with Reprocessing Service online which is available to you, or using a nearby Industry Command Ship with a compressor activated.
blocks.zh: 原矿体积很大，运输时占用大量货舱空间。压缩可以把原矿转换为压缩矿石，从而节省宝贵的货舱空间，延长采矿舰队的作业时间，并提高运输舰的运力。压缩有两种方式：前往一座你可以使用、且提炼服务已上线的昇威建筑，或者使用附近已激活压缩器的工业指挥舰。

blocks.en: Mercoxit mining
blocks.zh: 基腹断岩开采

blocks.en: Any ore mining module can mine any type of ore, with one exception: Mercoxit, the rarest ore type (and only source of Morphite minerals), which is found only in nullsec systems and can only be mined with Deep Core mining modules (any module with "deep core" in its name). In order to use these modules you need to train Deep Core Mining, and whilst they can be used to mine other types of ore, they are less efficient at it than "normal" mining modules.
blocks.zh: 任何矿石采矿装备都能开采任何种类的矿石，只有一个例外：基腹断岩，这是最稀有的矿石（也是莫尔石矿物的唯一来源），只分布在00 区星系，并且只能用深层地核采矿装备（名字中带有“深层地核”的装备）开采。要使用这些装备，你需要训练深核开采法研究；它们虽然也能开采其他矿石，但效率不如“普通”采矿装备。

blocks.en: Mercoxit mining has one other notable feature: when you mine a Mercoxit asteroid, it will randomly release a cloud of toxic gas which will damage your ship if you're caught in it. Fortunately, the cloud only forms within 5 km of the asteroid, so keep your ship further away to escape any damage (note that this precludes you from using the basic Deep Core Mining Laser I module, as it has a maximum range of only 5 km). Additionally, you can train Deep Core Mining, which reduces the chance of a cloud forming by 10% per skill level—in other words, at Deep Core Mining V, only half the amount of clouds will spawn when you mine Mercoxit.
blocks.zh: 基腹断岩开采还有另一个值得注意的特点：开采基腹断岩小行星时，它会随机释放一团有毒气体，如果你的船处在其中就会受到伤害。好在毒云只会在小行星 5 km 范围内形成，所以让船保持在更远的位置即可避免伤害（注意这意味着你不能使用基础的深层地核采矿激光器 I，因为它的最大射程只有 5 km）。此外，你可以训练深核开采法研究，每级降低 10% 的毒云生成几率——也就是说，深核开采法研究 V 时，开采基腹断岩产生的毒云数量只有原来的一半。

blocks.en: Ice and gas harvesting
blocks.zh: 冰矿与气云采集

blocks.en: In addition to ore, ice and gas can also be harvested. While the actual harvesting mechanics are fairly similar, the ships, equipment, and locations differ significantly from mining ore. (Further details can be found in ice harvesting and gas cloud harvesting.)
blocks.zh: 除了矿石，还可以采集冰矿和气云。虽然实际的采集机制相当类似，但所用的舰船、装备和地点与矿石开采差别很大。（更多详情请参阅冰矿采集和气云采集。）

blocks.en: Ships
blocks.zh: 舰船

blocks.en: Main article: ORE Basic Ship and Skill Overview
blocks.zh: 主条目：联合矿业舰船与技能基础概览

blocks.en: There are three types of ships used in mining: a mining ship, a hauler and a mining support ship.
blocks.zh: 采矿用到的舰船分三类：采矿舰、运输舰和采矿支援舰。

blocks.en: Mining ships
blocks.zh: 采矿舰

blocks.en: The Venture, an entry-level dedicated mining frigate.
blocks.zh: 冲锋者级，入门级专用采矿护卫舰。

blocks.en: The best option for a new miner is to train into the Venture, a dedicated ORE mining frigate (before the Retribution expansion, each race had its own mining frigate, but this is no longer the case). The Venture is given out for free by the industrialist career agents. The Venture is a mini mining barge with a substantial mining hold (which minimizes travel to stations to unload ore), very good mining yield and built-in warp core stabilization (which makes it easier to escape from hostile ships).
blocks.zh: 对新矿工来说，最佳选择是训练驾驶冲锋者级，这是一艘联合矿业专用采矿护卫舰（在惩戒（Retribution）资料片之前，每个种族都有自己的采矿护卫舰，但现在已不是这样）。工业生涯代理人会免费发放冲锋者级。冲锋者级就像一艘迷你采矿驳船，拥有可观的矿石舱（减少回站卸矿的往返次数）、非常不错的采矿产量，以及内置的跃迁核心稳定（更容易从敌对舰船手中逃脱）。

blocks.en: After a week's training, a budding miner should have the necessary skills to fly a mining barge, which have more than double the mining yield of a Venture, as well as even larger mining holds and/or a stronger tank. These ships are also more expensive (15–40M ISK, plus modules), but given that a Venture can mine about 500–700k ISK worth of ore per full mining hold, this money is soon earned. There are three different mining barges, each with a different focus (see table below).
blocks.zh: 训练一周后，初出茅庐的矿工应该就具备驾驶采矿驳船所需的技能了。采矿驳船的采矿产量是冲锋者级的两倍多，矿石舱更大和 / 或坦度更强。这些船也更贵（1500–4000 万 ISK，另加装备），但考虑到冲锋者级每装满一舱矿石大约值 50–70 万 ISK，这笔钱很快就能赚回来。采矿驳船共有三种，各有侧重（见下表）。

blocks.en: The last word in mining ships are the exhumers (Tech II variants of the mining barges). These ships require many more skills to fly, and are even more expensive, but have even greater mining yield, mining hold space and/or tank than the mining barges. Additionally, miners can train into the Prospect and the Endurance, improved variants of the Venture which are designed for covert mining in dangerous areas of space and ice mining, respectively.
blocks.zh: 采矿舰船的终极选择是采掘者（采矿驳船的 T2 版本）。这些船需要多得多的技能才能驾驶，价格也更贵，但采矿产量、矿石舱容量和 / 或坦度都比采矿驳船更高。此外，矿工还可以训练驾驶掘金者级和永恒者级，它们是冲锋者级的改进型，分别为在危险区域隐秘采矿和冰矿开采而设计。

blocks.en: Before the Retribution expansions, players often used cruisers or battleships as mining ships, but these ships are no longer competitive with mining barges and exhumers.
blocks.zh: 在惩戒资料片之前，玩家常用巡洋舰或战列舰来采矿，但如今这些船已无法与采矿驳船和采掘者竞争。

blocks.en: Haulers and support ships
blocks.zh: 运输舰与支援舰

blocks.en: A hauler's purpose is to take the ore that has been mined from a mining ship and transport it back to a refining station or to the market. Hauling is normally done in an hauler or a freighter.
blocks.zh: 运输舰的作用是把采矿舰采到的矿石运回提炼空间站或市场。运输通常使用运载舰或货舰。

blocks.en: Finally, a mining support ship can either come in the form of a security detail against rats and players looking to steal ore, or as a ship designed to provide mining efficiency bonuses. The ultimate mining support ships are the Orca and Rorqual, of which only the Orca can enter high-security space and fit through normal stargates.
blocks.zh: 最后，采矿支援舰可以是负责防范海盗 NPC 和偷矿玩家的护卫力量，也可以是专门提供采矿效率加成的舰船。终极采矿支援舰是逆戟鲸级和长须鲸级，其中只有逆戟鲸级能进入高安并通过普通星门。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Basic skills
blocks.zh: 基础技能

en: Mining (1x): +5% ore mining yield per level.
Astrogeology (3x): +5% ore mining yield per level; requires Mining IV.
zh: 采矿技术（1x）：每级 +5% 矿石采矿产量。
太空地质学（3x）：每级 +5% 矿石采矿产量；需要采矿技术 IV。

blocks.en: These skills are the bread and butter of any miner and should be trained up to level IV reasonably quickly (primarily for the increased mining yield, but Mining IV in particular is a prerequisite to many other mining-related skills). However, note that these skills only increase the yield for ore mining!
blocks.zh: 这些技能是每个矿工的基本功，应该尽快练到 IV 级（主要是为了提高采矿产量，而采矿技术 IV 更是许多其他采矿相关技能的前置）。不过要注意，这些技能只提高矿石开采的产量！

blocks.en: Specialty mining skills
blocks.zh: 特种采矿技能

en: Ice Harvesting (1x): Required for Ice Mining. 5% reduction in cycle time per level.
Gas Cloud Harvesting (1x): Required for Gas cloud harvesting. Allows use of one gas cloud harvester per level. Note that the skillbook is very expensive (about 30M ISK)!
Deep Core Mining (6x): Required for mining Mercoxit (a rare type of ore, only found in nullsec or wormholes).
zh: 冰矿采集理论（1x）：冰矿开采所需。每级减少 5% 周期时间。
气云采集理论（1x）：气云采集所需。每级允许使用一个气云采集器。注意技能书非常贵（约 3000 万 ISK）！
深核开采法研究（6x）：开采基腹断岩所需（一种稀有矿石，只分布在00 区或虫洞）。

blocks.en: These skills are only relevant if you want to expand from basic ore mining to Mercoxit, ice, or gas cloud harvesting.
blocks.zh: 只有当你想从基础矿石开采扩展到基腹断岩、冰矿或气云采集时，这些技能才有用。

blocks.en: Mining critical success skills
blocks.zh: 采矿暴击技能

en: Mining Precision (2x): 10% bonus per skill level to mining & ice harvesting critical success chance.
Mining Exploitation (6x): 5% bonus per skill level to mining & ice harvesting critical success bonus yield.
zh: 采矿精度（2x）：每级技能使采矿 & 冰矿采集暴击几率提高 10%。
矿石开采（6x）：每级技能使采矿 & 冰矿采集暴击额外产量提高 5%。

blocks.en: These skills provide smaller bonuses to mining or ice harvester yield compared to the skills above.
blocks.zh: 与上面的技能相比，这些技能对采矿或冰矿采集产量的加成较小。

blocks.en: Asteroid Ore reprocessing skills
blocks.zh: 小行星矿石提炼技能

en: Simple Ore Processing (3x): +2% per skill level to veldspar, scordite, pyroxeres, plagioclase and mordunium reprocessing yield.
Coherent Ore Processing (6x): +2% per skill level to omber, kernite, jaspet, hemorphite, hedbergite and ytirium reprocessing yield.
Variegated Ore Processing (9x): +2% per skill level to gneiss, dark ochre and crokite reprocessing yield.
Complex Ore Processing (11x): +2% per skill level to bistot, arkonor, spodumain, eifyrium and ducinium reprocessing yield.
Mercoxit Ore Processing (5x): +2% per skill level to mercoxit reprocessing yield.
Abyssal Ore Processing (12x): +2% per skill level to bezdnacine, rakovene and talassonite reprocessing yield.
Erratic Ore Processing (11x): +2% per skill level to prismaticite reprocessing yield.
zh: 普通矿石处理技术（3x）：每级技能使凡晶石、灼烧岩、干焦岩、斜长岩和莫德合金的提炼产出 +2%。
聚合矿石处理技术（6x）：每级技能使奥贝尔石、水硼砂、杰斯贝矿、希莫非特、同位原矿和耶利合金的提炼产出 +2%。
斑驳矿石处理技术（9x）：每级技能使片麻岩、黑赭石和克洛基石的提炼产出 +2%。
死亡空间矿石处理技术（11x）：每级技能使双多特石、艾克诺岩、灰岩、埃菲尔合金和杜厦合金的提炼产出 +2%。
基腹断岩处理技术（5x）：每级技能使基腹断岩的提炼产出 +2%。
深渊矿石处理技术（12x）：每级技能使贝兹岩、拉克岩和塔拉岩的提炼产出 +2%。
不稳定矿石处理（11x）：每级技能使棱柱石的提炼产出 +2%。

blocks.en: Moon ore reprocessing skills
blocks.zh: 卫星矿石提炼技能

en: Ubiquitous Moon Ore Processing (4x): +2% per skill level to all ubiquitous moon ore reprocessing yield.
Common Moon Ore Processing (5x): +2% per skill level to all common moon ore reprocessing yield.
Uncommon Moon Ore Processing (6x): +2% per skill level to all uncommon moon ore reprocessing yield.
Rare Moon Ore Processing (7x): +2% per skill level to all rare moon ore reprocessing yield.
Exceptional Moon Ore Processing (8x): +2% per skill level to all exceptional moon ore reprocessing yield.
zh: 常见卫星矿石处理技术（4x）：每级技能使所有常见卫星矿石的提炼产出 +2%。
普通卫星矿石处理技术（5x）：每级技能使所有普通卫星矿石的提炼产出 +2%。
罕见卫星矿石处理技术（6x）：每级技能使所有罕见卫星矿石的提炼产出 +2%。
稀有卫星矿石处理技术（7x）：每级技能使所有稀有卫星矿石的提炼产出 +2%。
非凡卫星矿石处理技术（8x）：每级技能使所有非凡卫星矿石的提炼产出 +2%。

blocks.en: These skills are important if you wish to reprocess your own ores, and they unlock access to mining crystals which massively boost mining yield when fitted to appropriate mining harvester modules.
blocks.zh: 如果你想自己提炼矿石，这些技能很重要；它们还能解锁采矿晶体，装到相应的采集装备上能大幅提高采矿产量。

blocks.en: Spaceship command skills
blocks.zh: 舰船操作技能

en: Mining Frigate (2x): Needed for the Venture.
Expedition Frigates (4x): Needed for the T2 hulls Prospect and Endurance.
Mining Destroyer (2x): Needed for the Pioneer.
Command Destroyers (6x): Needed for the T2 hull Outrider.
Mining Barge (4x): Needed for the Procurer, Retriever, and Covetor.
Exhumers (5x): Needed for the T2 hulls Skiff, Mackinaw, and Hulk.
Industrial Command Ships (8x): Needed for the Porpoise and Orca.
Capital Industrial Ships (12x): Needed for the Rorqual.
zh: 采矿护卫舰操作（2x）：驾驶冲锋者级所需。
勘探护卫舰操作（4x）：驾驶 T2 船体掘金者级和永恒者级所需。
采矿驱逐舰（2x）：驾驶开拓者级所需。
指挥驱逐舰操作（6x）：驾驶 T2 船体先驱级所需。
采矿驳船操作（4x）：驾驶猎获级、回旋者级和妄想级所需。
采掘者操作（5x）：驾驶 T2 船体轻舟级、麦基诺级和霍克级所需。
工业指挥舰操作（8x）：驾驶海豚级和逆戟鲸级所需。
旗舰级工业舰操作（12x）：驾驶长须鲸级所需。

blocks.en: In addition to letting you fly the mentioned ships (which only needs level I), training higher ranks of these skills greatly enhance their respective ships. For instance, the Venture gains +5% mining yield per level of the Mining Frigate skill—which is on top of the bonuses provided by Mining and Astrogeology! So if you've found a ship you like, train the corresponding spaceship command skill to make it even better.
blocks.zh: 除了让你能驾驶上述舰船（只需 I 级），把这些技能练到更高等级还能大幅强化对应的舰船。例如，采矿护卫舰操作每升一级，冲锋者级就获得 +5% 采矿产量——这是在采矿技术和太空地质学加成之外额外叠加的！所以如果你找到了一艘喜欢的船，就去训练对应的舰船操作技能，让它变得更强。

blocks.en: Upgrade module skills
blocks.zh: 改良装备技能

en: Mining Upgrades (4x): Required for fitting and using Mining Upgrades. Requires Mining III.
zh: 矿冶提升理论（4x）：装配和使用采矿改良设备所需。需要采矿技术 III。

blocks.en: As mining lasers and mining upgrades are CPU-hungry, training CPU Management will make it easier to fit your ship.
blocks.zh: 由于采矿激光器和采矿改良设备都很吃 CPU，训练CPU管理学会让装配更容易。

blocks.en: Drone skills
blocks.zh: 无人机技能

en: Drones (1x): Increases number of drones in space by 1 per level, for a maximum of five drones in space at level V.
Drone Interfacing (5x): Increases drone damage and mining drone yield by 10% per level. Requires Drones V.
Mining Drone Operation (2x): Increases mining drone yield by 5% per level. Requires Drones I.
Mining Drone Specialization (5x): Further increases mining drone yield by 2% per skill level and unlocks T2 mining drones.
zh: 无人机概论（1x）：每级使可同时放出的无人机数量 +1，V 级时最多可放出五架。
无人机控制理论（5x）：每级使无人机伤害和采矿无人机产量提高 10%。需要无人机概论 V。
采矿无人机操控理论（2x）：每级使采矿无人机产量提高 5%。需要无人机概论 I。
采矿无人机专业研究（5x）：每级技能使采矿无人机产量再提高 2%，并解锁 T2 采矿无人机。

blocks.en: Mining ships use drones both for defense and increased mining yield. The Drones skill is the foundation skill and should be eventually trained up to V (once you start flying Exhumers it's highly recommended, and valuable even before). To use drones defensively, train up Light Drone Operation, whilst mining drones need Mining Drone Operation. Drone Interfacing is somewhat of a long train, but even getting it to level IV makes a big difference in how effective your drones are. Advanced Drone Avionics is only needed if you plan to use ECM drones, and the drone specialization skills are needed when you start using Tech II drones. For more details on how drones work, see drones.
blocks.zh: 采矿舰船既用无人机自卫，也用它们提高采矿产量。无人机概论是基础技能，最终应该练到 V 级（开始驾驶采掘者后强烈推荐，之前练也很有价值）。要用无人机自卫，训练轻型无人机操控理论；采矿无人机则需要采矿无人机操控理论。无人机控制理论训练时间较长，但哪怕只练到 IV 级，也能让无人机效果大不一样。只有打算使用 ECM 无人机时才需要高级无人机电子理论，开始使用 T2 无人机时则需要相应的无人机专业研究技能。关于无人机运作方式的更多详情，请参阅无人机。

blocks.en: Fleet Support skills
blocks.zh: 舰队支援技能

en: Leadership (1x), Wing Command (8x), and Fleet Command (12x): Increases Command Burst area of effect.
Mining Foreman (2x): Increases duration of Mining Foreman Command Bursts. Requires Leadership I.
Mining Director (5x): Increases the strength of Mining Foreman Command Bursts. Requires Mining Foreman V.
Command Burst Specialist (6x): Reduces reload time for Command Burst modules. Requires Leadership V.
zh: 领导理论（1x）、联队指挥学（8x）和舰队指挥学（12x）：扩大指挥脉冲波的作用范围。
开采先锋技术（2x）：延长开采先锋指挥脉冲波的持续时间。需要领导理论 I。
采矿管理技术（5x）：提高开采先锋指挥脉冲波的强度。需要开采先锋技术 V。
指挥脉冲波专业研究（6x）：缩短指挥脉冲波装备的装填时间。需要领导理论 V。

blocks.en: These skills become highly desirable once pilots start flying Orcas or Rorquals, and want to run mining fleets (and provide mining boosts to your fleet members). For more details on how fleets and Command Bursts work, see Command Bursts.
blocks.zh: 当飞行员开始驾驶逆戟鲸级或长须鲸级、想要组织采矿舰队（并为舰队成员提供采矿加成）时，这些技能就非常值得练了。关于舰队和指挥脉冲波运作方式的更多详情，请参阅指挥脉冲波。

blocks.en: Other skills
blocks.zh: 其他技能

en: Almost all the mining ships are shield tanked, so shield tanking skills are useful to make them less vulnerable to ganking.
General fitting skills will improve the PG and CPU output of your ship allowing better fits.
zh: 几乎所有采矿舰船都是护盾坦，所以护盾坦克技能有助于降低被自杀式攻击的风险。
通用装配技能能提高舰船的能量栅格和 CPU 输出，让你装出更好的配置。

blocks.en: If you are still short on CPU, Electronics Upgrades allow you to fit co-processor modules (which increase your ship's CPU further). Mining upgrade modules increase your mining yield, while drone augmentor rigs increase the yield of mining drones.
blocks.zh: 如果 CPU 还是不够，电子升级研究可以让你装配协处理器（进一步提高舰船 CPU）。采矿改良设备能提高采矿产量，无人机增强改装件则能提高采矿无人机的产量。

blocks.en: Implants
blocks.zh: 植入体

blocks.en: A number of implants can improve a miner's performance, such as increasing mining yield, increasing laser range, or decreasing the CPU penalty for mining upgrade modules. For details on these implants, see implants and skill hardwiring implants ("Industry" implants).
blocks.zh: 有不少植入体可以提升矿工的表现，比如提高采矿产量、增加激光射程，或降低采矿改良设备的 CPU 惩罚。这些植入体的详情请参阅植入体和技能硬连线植入体（“工业”植入体）。

blocks.en: Mining strategies
blocks.zh: 采矿策略

blocks.en: Bookmarks
blocks.zh: 书签

blocks.en: An example of mining bookmarks in an asteroid belt
blocks.zh: 小行星带中采矿书签的示例

blocks.en: When you warp to an asteroid belt, you will land in the middle of a semicircle of asteroids about 50 km in diameter. Since the (unboosted) range of mining lasers is only 10 km (15 km for strip miners), you will then need to fly closer to your target asteroid in order to mine it—and mining ships are not particularly known for their speed. You can cut down on this travel time by using bookmarks, which allow you to warp directly next to an asteroid, and start mining immediately. If you're using mining drones, it's particularly important to be close to your target asteroid, as the drones have to otherwise spend a lot of time traveling back and forth between your ship and the asteroid.
blocks.zh: 跃迁到小行星带时，你会落在一个直径约 50 km 的小行星半圆的中间。由于采矿激光器的（无加成）射程只有 10 km（露天采矿器为 15 km），你需要飞近目标小行星才能开采——而采矿舰船的速度可不怎么样。使用书签可以缩短这段飞行时间，它能让你直接跃迁到小行星旁边，马上开始采矿。如果你使用采矿无人机，靠近目标小行星就尤为重要，否则无人机要花大量时间在你的船和小行星之间往返。

blocks.en: It can be helpful to create bookmarks in the asteroid belts you mine in frequently. While there are many different approaches to creating these bookmarks, the picture on the right shows a simple example: warp to an asteroid belt in a fast ship (e.g. a shuttle or a frigate), and create three bookmarks along the perimeter of the belt. Position them in such a way that most of the belt is within 15 km (the range of a strip miner) of any of the three bookmarks. Then, switch to your mining ship, and warp directly to one of the three bookmarks. You will then have a large selection of asteroids within range of your lasers, and be able to efficiently use mining drones on the closest ones. If a part of the belt is depleted, warp to a nearby celestial (e.g. a planet) and then warp back to one of the other bookmarks in the belt.
blocks.zh: 在经常采矿的小行星带中创建书签会很有帮助。创建书签的方法有很多，右图展示了一个简单的例子：用一艘快船（例如穿梭机或护卫舰）跃迁到小行星带，沿小行星带外围创建三个书签。摆放位置要让小行星带的大部分都处在这三个书签中任意一个的 15 km（露天采矿器射程）范围内。然后换上采矿船，直接跃迁到三个书签之一。这样你的激光射程内就会有大量小行星可选，还能对最近的小行星高效使用采矿无人机。如果小行星带的某一部分被采空了，就跃迁到附近的天体（例如行星），再跃迁回小行星带的另一个书签。

blocks.en: When mining in NULL sec space it is extremely important to create a couple of tactical bookmarks around the asteroid/ice belt that you should warp to first. When you are in a large mining ship the align and warp speed can mean that hostile pilots can appear in local and beat you to the belt before you get there. By warping to the tactical bookmark first you are giving yourself a chance to warp away to a safe spot or station before the hostile pilot can get a lock on you.
blocks.zh: 在 00 区采矿时，在小行星带 / 冰矿带周围创建几个战术书签并先跃迁到那里，这一点极其重要。驾驶大型采矿船时，由于对准和跃迁速度慢，敌对飞行员可能出现在本地频道后比你先抵达小行星带。先跃迁到战术书签，你就有机会在敌对飞行员锁定你之前跃迁到安全点或空间站。

blocks.en: Avoiding threats
blocks.zh: 规避威胁

blocks.en: Nowhere in EVE is safe as soon as you undock your ship. You consent to PvP no matter where you go as soon as you undock.
blocks.zh: 一旦离站，EVE 里就没有哪里是安全的。无论去哪里，只要离站，就意味着你同意参与 PvP。

blocks.en: Highsec
blocks.zh: 高安

blocks.en: In highsec, the main threat will be suicide gankers. Suicide gankers typically act in groups, trying to find vulnerable and/or valuable mining ships and attempting to destroy them before Concord shows up. Then a neutral pilot will come in and scoop the remains of your wreck. You're less likely to have your pod destroyed, as doing so hits the offending pilot with a large security standing penalty, but it can still happen, so warping out immediately is recommended.
blocks.zh: 在高安，主要威胁是自杀式攻击者。自杀式攻击者通常成群行动，寻找脆弱和 / 或值钱的采矿船，试图在统合部赶到之前摧毁它们。随后会有一个中立飞行员过来捡走你残骸里的东西。你的太空舱被击毁的可能性较小，因为这样做会让攻击者的安全等级受到重罚，但仍有可能发生，所以建议立即跃迁离开。

blocks.en: Popular ganking ships include:
blocks.zh: 常见的自杀式攻击舰船包括：

en: Catalyst: Most popular suicide ganking ship. Relatively inexpensive and good DPS.
Coercer: Often used to take down ships with sturdy shields due to decent amount of EM damage which shields are usually weaker to.
Talos: Usually used against big and/or tanky targets due to its high DPS against larger ships. Relatively expensive compared to other options.
zh: 促进级：最常用的自杀式攻击舰船。相对便宜，DPS 不错。
强制者级：由于能打出可观的电磁伤害，而护盾通常对电磁伤害较弱，常用来击杀护盾坚固的舰船。
塔洛斯级：对大型舰船 DPS 很高，通常用来对付大型和 / 或高坦度目标。与其他选择相比相对昂贵。

blocks.en: To avoid suicide ganking:
blocks.zh: 规避自杀式攻击：

en: Equip your mining ships with defensive modules. The more EHP your ship has, the more ships it takes for a group of suicide gankers to take down your ship. It also makes it less financially motivational for them to attack you.

Don't equip expensive faction or officer modules on your ship. This makes you a juicy target by increasing the financial incentive to suicide gank your ship. T2 modules are more than appropriate for most needs.
Mine further away from trade hubs, as this makes it less likely for a suicide ganker or a scout to spot your ship in the first place.
Don't mine while away from the keyboard. Dock if you must leave the keyboard unattended.
Set negative standings for known suicide ganker pilots/corporations/alliances. If you see someone or a group appear in local with negative standings, dock up as soon as possible.
zh: 给采矿船装上防御装备。你的船有效生命值（EHP）越高，自杀式攻击团伙就需要越多的船才能击毁它，也降低了他们攻击你的经济动机。
不要在船上装昂贵的势力或官员装备。这会提高击毁你的经济收益，让你成为一块肥肉。T2 装备足以满足大多数需求。
在离贸易中心较远的地方采矿，这样自杀式攻击者或侦察兵一开始就不太容易发现你的船。
不要挂机采矿。如果必须离开键盘，请停靠。
给已知的自杀式攻击飞行员 / 军团 / 联盟设置负声望。如果看到负声望的个人或团体出现在本地频道，尽快停靠。

blocks.en: Other threats:
blocks.zh: 其他威胁：

en: If you're enrolled in faction warfare, then the opposing faction can freely attack you with no consequences, even in highsec as long as you are enrolled.

If your corporation is at war with another corporation, the hostile corporation can freely attack you with no consequences for the duration of the war. This is more rare nowadays since corporations need a structure to be war eligible and the practice of holding corporations for structures pretty much voids this risk.

♢ pirates can appear in asteroid belts if there is a pirate stronghold present in the system. These rats can call other ♢ combat rats as reinforcements that can disrupt/scram your warp drive. You can check the presence of a pirate stronghold using your directional scanner.

♢ NPC miners can appear in asteroid belts. If you have low enough standings to the NPC corporation, they'll be hostile to you and call combat ♢ NPCs as reinforcements that can disrupt/scram your warp drive. You can warp out safely as soon as you spot them, but delaying will likely result in you losing your ship.

Normal NPC pirates aren't much of a threat, but with enough time they can potentially destroy your ship (depending on fittings) and assist pilots in destroying your ship. Drones can take care of them easily.
Triglavians can be a problem if you have no/low standings with them. EDENCOM similarly can be an issue if your standings are low enough.
zh: 如果你加入了势力战争，敌对势力可以随意攻击你而不受任何惩罚，即使在高安也是如此，只要你仍在参战。
如果你的军团与另一个军团处于战争状态，敌对军团在战争期间可以随意攻击你而不受任何惩罚。如今这种情况较少见了，因为军团需要拥有建筑才能被宣战，而用专门的控股军团持有建筑的做法基本消除了这种风险。
如果星系中存在海盗要塞，♢ 海盗可能会出现在小行星带。这些海盗 NPC 会呼叫其他 ♢ 战斗 NPC 增援，它们能干扰 / 扰断你的跃迁引擎。可以用定向扫描检查是否存在海盗要塞。
♢ NPC 矿工可能会出现在小行星带。如果你对该 NPC 军团的声望足够低，它们会对你怀有敌意，并呼叫战斗 ♢ NPC 增援，这些 NPC 能干扰 / 扰断你的跃迁引擎。一发现它们就跃迁离开是安全的，但拖延很可能会让你丢船。
普通海盗 NPC 威胁不大，但时间够长的话也可能击毁你的船（取决于装配），并协助其他飞行员击毁你的船。无人机可以轻松解决它们。
如果你对三神裔没有声望或声望较低，他们可能会是个麻烦。同样，如果你对伊甸联合防御阵线的声望足够低，它们也可能成为问题。

blocks.en: Lowsec
blocks.zh: 低安

blocks.en: In lowsec, pretty much anyone can attack you for a relatively small standing penalty (Concord won't intervene). Gate and station guns will shoot at pilots that attack you unprovoked, but they can be tanked and thus not be a good deterrent. Gate camps are fairly common. Smartbombers can be an issue if you use smaller ships. You'll often see people deploy covert cynos to drop a group of enemy pilots on you.
blocks.zh: 在低安，几乎任何人都可以攻击你，只会受到相对较小的安全等级惩罚（统合部不会介入）。星门和空间站的岗哨炮会射击无故攻击你的飞行员，但这些火力可以硬扛，所以威慑力有限。蹲星门的情况相当常见。如果你用的是小船，范围炸弹（Smartbomb）船可能会是个问题。你还会经常看到有人开启隐秘诱导力场，把一群敌对飞行员拉到你面前。

blocks.en: Avoiding ganks:
blocks.zh: 规避攻击：

en: Definitely use the directional scanner to gather intel on locals and spot threats.
Learn the locals. Find out who attacks other people unprovoked and ships they typically use. Find out who snitches your position too if it happens.
Equip a cloaking device and try to mine on the opposite side of the asteroids, with enough distance so you can immediately cloak in case someone appears in the system.
Stay away from systems near highsec, as these have a lot of traffic and you can easily be scouted.
Avoid popular paths through lowsec, for the same reasons as above. Best to pick dead-end systems off the main travelled paths.
Mine while nobody is present in the system, or only if you're sure the locals are of no threat to you. If someone shows up, cloak or dock.

Don't leave wrecks hanging around as their presence can betray your purpose in the system. If people see wrecks in an asteroid belt or ore anomaly, they can think you're there mining and persist in trying to find you. Either salvage or destroy them.
Try to be wary of where people are and were in the system. People can log out in a belt and login later to catch you unaware.
zh: 一定要用定向扫描收集本地玩家的情报、发现威胁。
了解本地玩家。弄清楚谁会无故攻击别人、他们常用什么船，以及谁会出卖你的位置（如果有的话）。
装一个隐形装置，尽量在小行星的另一侧采矿，并保持足够距离，以便有人进入星系时能立即隐形。
远离靠近高安的星系，那里流量大，你很容易被侦察到。
出于同样的原因，避开低安的热门路线。最好选择偏离主要航道的死路星系。
在星系里没人的时候采矿，或者只在确定本地玩家对你没有威胁时采矿。有人出现就隐形或停靠。
不要留下残骸，它们会暴露你在星系里的目的。如果有人在小行星带或矿石异常中看到残骸，可能会认为你在那里采矿，并锲而不舍地找你。要么打捞，要么摧毁它们。
留意星系里的人现在和之前都在哪里。有人可能会在小行星带下线，之后再上线趁你不备抓你。

blocks.en: Avoiding gate camps:
blocks.zh: 规避蹲门：

en: Use third-party utilities to find gate camps. Note that these third party tools won't have knowledge of gate camps if you're the first person to encounter one.
Alternatively you can check ship/pod kill statistics for systems in your route.
If you have an alt, you can make them jump ahead of you to spot gate camps.
zh: 用第三方工具查找蹲门情况。注意，如果你是第一个遇到的人，这些第三方工具不会知道那里有人蹲门。
或者，你也可以查看路线上各星系的舰船 / 太空舱击毁统计。
如果你有小号，可以让小号先跳过去侦察有没有人蹲门。

en: Normal NPC pirates start fielding destroyers up the battleships the lower the security of the system descends.

Clone Soldiers can rarely spawn in the asteroid belts.
Triglavians can be a problem if you have no/low standings with them. EDENCOM similarly can be an issue if your standings are low enough.
zh: 星系安全等级越低，普通海盗 NPC 出动的舰船就越大，从驱逐舰到战列舰都有。
莫德指挥官偶尔会出现在小行星带，能进行跃迁干扰。
克隆士兵偶尔会出现在小行星带。
如果你对三神裔没有声望或声望较低，他们可能会是个麻烦。同样，如果你对伊甸联合防御阵线的声望足够低，它们也可能成为问题。

blocks.en: Sovnull
blocks.zh: 主权 00 区

blocks.en: Mining in sovnull is usually done if you've the backing of the sovereignty holder or its allies. Hostiles will usually be neutral pilots or enemies of your sovereignty holder. Warp disrupting bubbles can be deployed.
blocks.zh: 通常只有在得到主权持有者或其盟友支持的情况下，才会在主权 00 区采矿。敌对方通常是中立飞行员或你所在主权方的敌人。对方可能会部署跃迁扰断泡泡。

blocks.en: Sovnull systems are lawless, so there is no consequence for attacking another pilot.
blocks.zh: 主权 00 区星系无法无天，攻击其他飞行员不会受到任何惩罚。

blocks.en: In wormholes, other pilots aren't shown in local unless they have recently sent a message. The only way to spot other players is to use the directional scanner, or if they appear in your grid. Warp disrupting bubbles can be deployed.

blocks.en: Solo mining
blocks.zh: 单人采矿

blocks.en: The Hulk: sucking asteroid belts dry since 2003
blocks.zh: 霍克级：自 2003 年起就在把小行星带吸干

blocks.en: Mining hold mining
blocks.zh: 矿石舱采矿

blocks.en: The most basic way to mine is to fill the mining hold of a ship full of ore and then return to a station to drop it off. Its advantages are that it requires only one character, can be done at very low skill levels and is completely theft-proof. Its disadvantage is that the time you spend traveling to and from a station is wasted (i.e. not spent mining)—however, most mining ships (with the notable exception of the Covetor and the Hulk) have large enough mining holds that they do not need to return frequently to a station to unload.
blocks.zh: 最基本的采矿方式是把舰船的矿石舱装满，然后回空间站卸货。它的优点是只需要一个角色，技能等级很低也能做，而且完全不会被偷。缺点是往返空间站的时间被浪费掉了（即没有用来采矿）——不过大多数采矿船（妄想级和霍克级是明显的例外）的矿石舱都足够大，不需要频繁回站卸货。

blocks.en: As an example: An average-skilled miner flying a Venture can mine about 250 m3/min of ore, which is enough to fill the Venture's mining hold (5000 m3) in about 20 minutes. Given that the Venture aligns and warps like a frigate, round trips to a station will take only a minute or two, so very little time is lost. A highly-skilled miner flying a Hulk, on the other hand, can mine about 1600 m3/min of ore, which will fill the Hulk's mining hold (11,500 m3) in about 7 minutes, requiring frequent return trips to a station (made longer by the slow align time and warp speed of the Hulk).
blocks.zh: 举个例子：一位技能中等的矿工驾驶冲锋者级，每分钟大约能采 250 m3 矿石，大约 20 分钟就能装满冲锋者级的矿石舱（5000 m3）。由于冲锋者级的对准和跃迁跟护卫舰一样快，往返空间站只需一两分钟，损失的时间很少。而一位高技能矿工驾驶霍克级，每分钟大约能采 1600 m3 矿石，大约 7 分钟就会装满霍克级的矿石舱（11,500 m3），需要频繁回站（霍克级对准慢、跃迁速度低，使往返更加耗时）。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Prior to the introduction of the Venture mining frigate in the Retribution expansion, cargohold mining was very unprofitable, but was the best option for new miners until a mining barge could be afforded.
blocks.zh: 在惩戒资料片推出冲锋者级采矿护卫舰之前，货舱采矿非常不赚钱，但在买得起采矿驳船之前，这是新矿工的最佳选择。

blocks.en: Jetcan and GSC mining
blocks.zh: 抛货柜与巨型安全货柜采矿

blocks.en: Players can jettison items from their holds into space, which results in a cargo container (more commonly called a "jetcan" or just a "can") forming within 2,500 m of the ship. This jettisoned container has a volume capacity of 55,000 m3. Miners can take advantage of this capacity by transferring the ore in their mining hold into the jetcan. Typically a player will fill a jetcan with ore, and then (once the jetcan is full) swap to a ship with a larger mining/cargo hold (most often an hauler) and haul the ore to a nearby station.
blocks.zh: 玩家可以把舱内物品抛到太空中，这样会在舰船 2,500 m 范围内形成一个货柜（通常叫“抛货柜”，或者直接叫“罐子”）。抛出的货柜容量为 55,000 m3。矿工可以利用这个容量，把矿石舱里的矿石转移到抛货柜中。通常玩家会把抛货柜装满矿石，然后（装满后）换上一艘矿石舱 / 货舱更大的船（多数是运载舰），把矿石运到附近的空间站。

blocks.en: If you're flying a mining ship with a mining hold that's considerably smaller than a jetcan (such as a Venture (5,000 m3 mining hold) or a Covetor (9,000 m3 mining hold)), this method can increase your efficiency, as you can spend more time mining and less time hauling. As all other mining ships have mining holds which are as large or larger than a jetcan (in addition to the time lost in changing ships and the risk of getting your ore stolen), using jetcans is probably not worth your time. They do, however, come in very handy if you're mining with two accounts or in a fleet (see below).
blocks.zh: 如果你驾驶的采矿船矿石舱比抛货柜小得多（例如冲锋者级（矿石舱 5,000 m3）或妄想级（矿石舱 9,000 m3）），这种方法可以提高效率，因为你可以把更多时间花在采矿上，花在运输上的时间更少。而其他采矿船的矿石舱都和抛货柜一样大或更大（再加上换船浪费的时间和矿石被偷的风险），使用抛货柜大概不值得。不过如果你用两个账号采矿或参加舰队采矿（见下文），它们就非常好用了。

blocks.en: Note that jetcans only have a lifespan of 2 hours and they are not secure, meaning anyone can open and remove items from a jetcan. This is a common form of theft and griefing in the game, where a player will "flip" a jetcan either to steal the ore or to induce a fight without CONCORD intervention. While it's possible to combat this by using secure containers (which can be programmed with a password), the largest of these (the giant secure container, often called a GSC) can only hold 3,900 m3 of ore, which is less than the mining hold on even the smallest mining ship (although using them was a commonly-used practice in the past when mining ships had much smaller cargo holds).
blocks.zh: 注意，抛货柜只存在 2 小时，而且不安全，也就是说任何人都可以打开抛货柜并拿走里面的物品。这是游戏中一种常见的偷窃和恶意骚扰手段：玩家会“翻罐”，要么为了偷矿，要么为了在统合部不介入的情况下挑起战斗。虽然可以用安全货柜（可以设置密码）来应对，但其中最大的（巨大的安全货柜，常称 GSC）也只能装 3,900 m3 矿石，比最小的采矿船的矿石舱还小（不过在过去采矿船货舱小得多的时候，使用它们是很常见的做法）。

blocks.en: A better alternative to GSCs are mobile tractor units. They have nearly as much capacity as a jetcan, are unable to be accessed by random people, and have a decay of 2 days. They also suck in and store any ore a miner might jetcan into a safer place. A mining barge can store 3 MTUs and deploy them for a temporary total of 81,000 m3 of extra space. This allows for a large amount of time to be saved from station mining, as a miner instead of having to dock up can just jetcan the ore to be stored for later.
blocks.zh: 比巨型安全货柜更好的选择是移动式牵引装置（MTU）。它的容量几乎和抛货柜一样大，路人无法访问，衰减时间为 2 天。它还会把矿工抛出的矿石吸进来，存放在更安全的地方。一艘采矿驳船可以携带 3 个 MTU，部署后能临时获得总计 81,000 m3 的额外空间。这样可以省下大量回站的时间，矿工无需停靠，只要把矿石抛出来存着以后再取即可。

blocks.en: Dual account mining
blocks.zh: 双账号采矿

blocks.en: If you have two EVE accounts, you can multibox them (i.e. play them on one computer simultaneously). One of these can mine while the other one flies a hauler to drop the mined ore at a nearby station. The miner transfers the mined ore into a jetcan or a GSC (see above) which is then picked up by the hauler. This way, the miner can mine non-stop, obtaining more ore. Eventually, the hauler character could train towards an Orca (to provide mining boosts to the miner, further increasing yield), while the miner character is free to train and fly ships like the Hulk, which have very high mining yield but small mining holds.
blocks.zh: 如果你有两个 EVE 账号，可以多开（即在一台电脑上同时玩）。一个号采矿，另一个号驾驶运载舰把采到的矿石送到附近的空间站。矿工把采到的矿石转移到抛货柜或巨型安全货柜（见上文），再由运输号取走。这样矿工可以不间断地采矿，获得更多矿石。之后运输角色可以朝逆戟鲸级方向训练（为矿工提供采矿加成，进一步提高产量），而矿工角色则可以放心训练和驾驶霍克级这类采矿产量很高但矿石舱很小的舰船。

blocks.en: See Creating an Alt Hauler and Creating an Alt Miner for tips on creating these alternate characters.
blocks.zh: 关于创建这些小号角色的建议，请参阅创建运输小号和创建采矿小号。

blocks.en: Cooperative mining
blocks.zh: 合作采矿

blocks.en: Main article: Mining Fleets
blocks.zh: 主条目：采矿舰队

blocks.en: The Orca: the easiest way to make yourself loved by miners.
blocks.zh: 逆戟鲸级：让矿工爱上你的最简单方法。

blocks.en: A standard mining fleet in high security space generally includes a mix of mining barges, exhumers, and haulers. The miners will work on a single belt constantly and transfer the ore they mine into a jetcan. The haulers will ferry the resources from space to a station. This makes for increased proficiency as the mining lasers never need to stop unless you need to switch belts. Fleet boosters are usually present here as well, and an Orca may be used instead of a jetcan. Mining fleets in low-sec will also include combat ships to protect the fleet against rats and hostile players.
blocks.zh: 高安的标准采矿舰队一般由采矿驳船、采掘者和运输舰混编而成。矿工持续在同一条小行星带作业，把采到的矿石转移到抛货柜中，运输舰则负责把资源从太空运到空间站。这样采矿激光器除非要换小行星带，否则永远不用停，效率更高。这里通常也会有舰队加成船，还可以用逆戟鲸级代替抛货柜。低安的采矿舰队还会配备战斗舰船，保护舰队免受海盗 NPC 和敌对玩家的威胁。

blocks.en: Splitting the ISK
blocks.zh: 分配 ISK

blocks.en: Since all the ore is combined into a single pot (and often refined and sold later), you need to agree on a method of splitting the proceeds from the mining fleet between the participants. Since a fleet often includes not only miners with different skill levels flying different ships, but also fleet boosters, haulers, combat ships etc, the simplest way to split the ISK proceeds is to allocate them based on time spent in the fleet; however, this might discourage larger ships from joining the fleet. Various spreadsheets or web applications such as eveminingfleet.ovh can accommodate several different methods of weighing the contributions of fleet members. Whichever way you choose, make sure that the method of splitting the ISK is agreed upon by the fleet before the mining op starts.
blocks.zh: 由于所有矿石都汇集到一起（通常之后会提炼再出售），你们需要商定一个在参与者之间分配采矿舰队收益的方法。舰队里不仅有技能等级不同、驾驶不同舰船的矿工，往往还有舰队加成船、运输舰、战斗舰船等，因此最简单的分配方法是按在舰队中的时间分配；不过这可能会让大船不愿意加入。各种电子表格或网页应用（例如 eveminingfleet.ovh）支持多种衡量舰队成员贡献的方法。无论选择哪种方式，一定要在采矿行动开始前让舰队就 ISK 分配方法达成一致。

blocks.en: Mining fleets in the Uni
blocks.zh: EVE University 的采矿舰队

blocks.en: Periodically, the Uni will undertake a large-scale, long-duration mining operation. These expeditions are planned and announced several weeks in advance to allow for adjustment of training schedules, acquisition of desired ships and fittings, and research/scouting of the target system and surrounding space. Because of the travel involved and the length of planned stay, expedition locations generally provide opportunities for mission/complex running as well.
blocks.zh: EVE University 会定期组织大规模、长时间的采矿行动。这些远征会提前几周计划和公布，让大家有时间调整训练计划、购置所需的舰船和装配，并对目标星系及周边空间进行研究 / 侦察。由于涉及长途旅行，计划停留时间也较长，远征地点通常也提供跑任务 / 刷复合体的机会。

blocks.en: The Expedition Boss for a particular expedition will publish the rules for that expedition, including record keeping requirements for any Common Can portions, rules for interaction with locals and what happens to the ore mined.
blocks.zh: 每次远征的远征负责人会公布该次远征的规则，包括公共货柜部分的记录要求、与本地玩家打交道的规则，以及采到的矿石如何处理。

blocks.en: Such fleets are often run to donate minerals to the University, with the added bonus of attempting to break the record for the previous donation fleet.
blocks.zh: 这类舰队通常是为了向 EVE University 捐赠矿物而组织的，额外的乐趣是尝试打破上一次捐赠舰队的纪录。

blocks.en: Mining fleets are generally more relaxed than combat fleets, co-operative mission running or complex clearing. Chat deals with a wider variety of topics and separating the required tasks to specialists provides everyone time to participate in the conversations. Not only does this atmosphere provide a social element of connection with the other members, but it also lets the "teaching" move beyond mining to cover a myriad of subjects.
blocks.zh: 采矿舰队通常比战斗舰队、合作跑任务或清理复合体更轻松。聊天话题更广泛，而且把必要的任务交给专人负责，让每个人都有时间参与聊天。这种氛围不仅提供了与其他成员交流的社交元素，也让“教学”不再局限于采矿，而是涵盖各种各样的话题。
